name: model-router
description: Routes simple prompts to a cheaper model so easy tasks stop eating your limits; /route to control it, !cheap or !main to force a prompt

cheapModel.title: Cheap model
cheapModel.description: Model id simple prompts are sent to

maxContextTokens.title: Max context for routing
maxContextTokens.description: Only route while the conversation is under this many tokens: past it, re-reading the whole context uncached on the cheap model can cost more than the main model's cache hit
